column1: # Room verification in Xcode Cloud (chapter 08 repair): one row per required execution of the candidate
# docs/verification/room-xcode-cloud-verification.md. The Codemagic rows these reuse are in
# with the same row IDs and test methods.
# Columns (tab-separated): row, plan, destination, test, proves, prior, last_seconds, required.
#   plan          TestPlans/<plan>.xctestplan; D2 is not in Xcode Cloud (see its row).
#   destination   the simulator the plan's Test action must run on. iPhone 17e is the 390 x 844 phone the
#                 Codemagic builds used; if Xcode Cloud does not offer it, iPhone 16e (also 390 x 844).
#   prior         the last results, by Codemagic build (b1 6abc1b80 on 51fe52a, b2 6abc2ae1 on 82eef53, b3
#                 6abc3654 on b5ee804, b4 6abc3ebe on c7716a1; docs/reports/room-chapter-08.md section 9).
#                 b5ee804 and c7716a1 build byte-identical apps.
#   last_seconds  the last measured test duration on Codemagic (Mac mini M2, iOS 26.5); for the smaller
#                 iPhone's regression rows, the run total measured in the Places recovery.
#   required      yes for every row: the product files changed after every earlier pass (RoomView,
#                 PlacesView and five scenes' width floors), so no earlier result carries over.
# Pass: every row executed once and passed at <CANDIDATE_SHA>. Skipped, not run, repeated or retried is
